svg.title: A parent can share commissions.
svg.desc: Continuing the same example: Alice receives thirty gross commission credits and chooses to share fifty percent. She retains fifteen and allocates fifteen to her immediate children. Bob escrows one hundred credits and Carol two hundred, receiving five and ten family credits respectively. The three hundred credits in escrow remain principal. The pool excludes Alice’s own-position rewards, admission fees, escrow principal, and incoming family allocations.

g.text: Children divide the offered pool by the credits they escrow.
from the source shown in the previous chart
The 300 escrowed credits remain withdrawable principal.
A child with zero escrow receives no family allocation.
